title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Saravanan feels relieved as the judge grants his divorce from Thangamayil, marking the end of their marriage. Bhagyam erupts in fury when Thangamayil refuses Saravanan's alimony.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan emotionally recalls Cheran's sacrifices and wishes to celebrate his wedding grandly as gratitude. Nila, Chozhan and Cheran formally present the invitation to Kasturi.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Sinthamani invites Annamalai's family to the reception, but Vijaya snaps when she insults Muthu. Muthu melts, while he and Meena worry for Chandra.

title: Neeya Naana
description: Gopinath hosts a debate on overspending youngsters facing family complaints about loan risks. Later, Writer Magudeeshwaran joins as the show advocates smart investments.

title: Super Singer Junior
episodeTitle: Retro Magic Takes Over the Stage
description: Retro classics come alive in the Rock 'n' Roll round through energetic performances. A special celebration honours Shruti Haasan's journey with a montage of her memorable moments.

title: Cooku With Comali
description: The grand finale kicks off with guest visits, hilarious comali picks, and high-stakes cooking. As tension rises, previous winners and judges brace to crown the champion!

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: Friendship Test Triggers Tension
description: Shobha and Saranya impress in the friendship challenges, while Aravind and Karishma clash during the Q&A round. Jayson gets candid about his friends as an eviction awaits.
